observations: Photo 0: close-up of an engine bay/engine showing valve cover, wiring harness, serpentine belt, alternator; no visible model plate or engine code.
Photo 1: engine wrapped in plastic for shipping, intake manifold and throttle body visible, no legible code or VIN tag.
Photo 2: top engine cover with a hand-written/embossed 'V6' marking visible, but no specific engine code (e.g. 2GR, 1MZ) readable.
No AC compressor, turbo, or separate operator parts clearly visible or labeled in any photo.
No odometer, dipstick, startup video, or documentation (customs/import papers) visible in any photo.
Background shows a cluttered yard with other engines wrapped in plastic, consistent with a used-parts dealer, not a dedicated clean shop.

identity.kind: Toyota V6 complete engine (claimed fit: Venza/Camry/Sienna/Highlander)

claims.claim: Complete engine with compressor and all the operators
claims.evidence: No compressor or distinct 'operator' parts (e.g. power steering pump, alternator set) clearly identifiable as a complete kit in any photo.

claims.claim: Fits Toyota Venza, Camry, Sienna, Highlander
claims.evidence: No engine code visible to confirm which generation/variant of these models it matches; fitment varies by year.
No shipping labels, customs tags, or documentation shown in any photo.
No startup video, compression test, or audio provided.
No odometer, service sticker, or mileage tag visible.
No seal, bolt-torque marks, or factory marks shown to confirm it has not been disassembled.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may knock despite claim
risks.proof: A clear video of the engine being started and idling, with audible sound.

risks.risk: Exact engine code/displacement unknown, affecting correct model-year fitment
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code/VIN stamp on the block (usually near bellhousing or front of block).
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unverified Toyota V6 without confirmed fitment

risks.risk: 'Complete with compressor and all operators' may be overstated; parts could be missing
risks.proof: Full-engine photo showing AC compressor, power steering pump, and alternator all attached and labeled.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete (bare long block equivalent)

risks.risk: Mileage claim unverifiable, could be high-mileage unit
risks.proof: Photo of odometer or Belgian import paperwork showing mileage at time of removal.

risks.risk: Import origin claim (Belgium) unverifiable, could affect trust in condition story
risks.proof: Photo of shipping manifest, customs clearance, or container tag.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code/stamp on the block (to confirm exact variant, e.g. 2GR-FE, 1MZ-FE, etc.).
Video of the engine running/idling with sound.
Photo showing the AC compressor, power steering pump, and alternator all mounted and intact.
Photo of any import/customs documentation or shipping tag confirming origin and mileage.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used Toyota V6 complete engine by type, but all seller claims (working condition, mileage, completeness, origin) are unverifiable from photos alone, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, possibly incomplete, non-running V6 unit.
